result.text:
Have seen claims that these were intercepted by Iron Beam, which is why they seem to fizzle out/explode after launch. 

I have doubts about this being true. It takes time for a laser weapon to actually destroy a projectile. Between that and time required to detect and engage this seems far too close to the ground to be a result of an Iron Beam intercept. Would also need to be very close to the launcher to have line of sight, that or would need to be positioned up high.
